description: Dredge won't spend real work on someone the shallow band could eat. Prove you can hold the deep reaches: put down the mutants that shamble the Rust Gallery and the hounds that work the Groaning Main, north and south of the Throat.
name: Deep Cuts

objectives.desc: Kill 3 deep mutants (bloated or rad) — try the Rust Gallery, south off the Throat.
emotes: {who} sets their feet and squares up against something far too big to be down here.
{who} drives a deep mutant back into the dark with a wet crack.

objectives.desc: Kill 2 gutter hounds — they run the Groaning Main, north off the Throat.
emotes: {who} puts a gutter hound down before it can circle behind.
